workarounds.symptom: Proxy start crashes with ValueError in find_blockers when the database encoding is SQL_ASCII
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(proxy): start on Postgres databases with SQL_ASCII encoding. Target files: litellm/proxy-extras/litellm_proxy_extras/migration_lock.py, litellm/proxy-extras/litellm_proxy_extras/request_log_indexes.py, litellm/proxy-extras/litellm_proxy_extras/utils.py. The proxy now starts and restarts on a Postgres database whose encoding is SQL_ASCII, and builds its request-log indexes there. Before, the first boot logged an error and skipped the indexes, and every later boot crashed. (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/53965)

workarounds.symptom: Model swap refuses model names that start with a digit (2N5485, 1N4148)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Accept a model name that starts with a digit in a model swap. Target files: src/ltspice_mcp/lib/instance_targeting.py, src/ltspice_mcp/lib/spice_lex.py, src/ltspice_mcp/lib/variations.py. A model swap in `run_experiments` refused part numbers such as `2N5486`, `1N4148` and `2N2222`. A `REF@model` assignment failed each case at submission, and the structured `instances` form refused the name at input. (Ref: https://github.com/Cognitohazard/ltspice-mcp/pull/318)

workarounds.symptom: Local workflow check points to a run list that requires a manager
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(runtime): suggest a local list when workflow check finds no run. Target files: implementations/runtime/smoke/run-command.smoke.ts, implementations/runtime/src/run-command.ts, .changeset/local-run-check-list.md. When `run check` could not find a run on a broker-only space, it suggested `cotal run`. That command uses the hosted listing route and refused because no manager was running. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/9703)

workarounds.symptom: A mistyped docs search option recommends adding a second search option
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): avoid suggesting a duplicate docs search option. Target files: implementations/cli/smoke/usage-format.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/src/command.ts, .changeset/docs-search-typo-suggestion.md. When `cotal docs` already had a `--search` query, a second flag mistyped as `--serch` suggested replacing it with `--search`. Following that advice still failed because `--search` cannot be repeated. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/9715)

workarounds.symptom: spawn_continue on a running follow-up's own id starts a second turn
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(subagent): refuse a running follow-up's own id as conversation_busy. Target files: src/kiro_crew/subagent_manager/continuation.py, test/test_subagent_continuable.py, docs/system-specs/modules/subagent.md. `spawn_continue` takes a conversation id. `ContinuationCoordinator` checks that conversation for a run in flight with `_conversation_busy("subagent:<id>")`, in `continue_conversation_async_impl` and again in `_continue_prelude_impl`. (Ref: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/pull/41483)

workarounds.symptom: litellm v1.108.16: Fixed a custom provider stream failing with `APIConnectionError: 'is_finished'` when a chunk lacks a field (#53417)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fixed a custom provider stream failing with `APIConnectionError: 'is_finished'` when a chunk lacks a field (#53417). Upstream PR #53417. (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/53417)

workarounds.symptom: The structured output reference tells history follow users to expect one JSON document
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): correct command guidance and endpoint imports. Target files: bin/smoke/docs-ext-read.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/smoke/completion-status.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/smoke/target-resolution.smoke.ts. Completion status now explains why a relative `ZDOTDIR` blocks managed zsh changes and points to an absolute path or manual setup instead of recommending a command that refuses. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/9622)

workarounds.symptom: fix(bench): validate grading rules before dispatching suite tasks
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(bench): validate suite grading before task submission. Target files: scripts/sutando_bench.py, tests/sutando-bench.test.py, docs/benchmarking.md. **Level:** medium **Reason:** Malformed grading rules can falsely pass benchmark answers or abort after task execution. (Ref: https://github.com/sonichi/sutando/pull/6620)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: /azure passthrough returns 500 "Provider openai not found" when body model is a non-Azure router group (regression in 1.109.1)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(proxy): only relay Azure passthrough model groups that are served by Azure. Target files: litellm/proxy/auth/auth_utils.py, litellm/proxy/pass_through_endpoints/llm_passthrough_endpoints.py, tests/unit/proxy/auth/test_auth_utils.py. Azure passthrough requests failed with a 500 when the model name matched a non-Azure model group on the proxy. They now go straight to Azure again, as they did before 1.109.1. (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/53904)

workarounds.symptom: Responses WebSocket leaks a parallel-request slot when pre-call processing fails after admission
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(proxy): release the parallel request slot when a Responses WebSocket is refused at open. Target files: litellm/proxy/hooks/parallel_request_limiter.py, litellm/proxy/response_api_endpoints/endpoints.py, litellm/proxy/utils.py. A Responses WebSocket that gets refused while it is opening now gives back the parallel request slot it took. Before this, the key stayed locked out of its own limit after the socket was already closed. (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/53902)

workarounds.symptom: Deadlock between `logging._lock` and `_QueueServiceBase._instance_lock` when `logging.config.dictConfig` runs while a service (e.g. `EventsWorker`) is being created
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Don't wait for service creation in `QueueService.drain_all`. Target files: src/prefect/_internal/concurrency/services.py, tests/_internal/concurrency/test_services.py. This PR stops `_QueueServiceBase.drain_all` from taking `_instance_lock`. This removes a deadlock between `logging.config.dictConfig` and the creation of a queue service such as `EventsWorker`. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/24049)
